environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (no IGW route). Origin is fronted by a CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing for custom origins. The ALB has a listener rule that validates the presence and cryptographic integrity of the x-amz-cf-id correlation header combined with a custom origin header (X-Origin-Verify) whose value is a rotating HMAC-SHA256 token generated by a Lambda@Edge origin-request function. The ALB security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront distribution has a Trusted Key Group with signed URL policy requiring valid RSA-2048 signature over resource path, expiry timestamp, and source IP CIDR restriction (/32). Signed URLs expire after 30 seconds. The CloudFront cache behavior for /api/v1/* has a query string allowlist limited to: 'format', 'locale', 'version' — the 'expr' parameter is NOT in the allowlist and is stripped before forwarding to origin.

config.deployment: AWS EC2 t3.medium, private subnet, no NAT for inbound
config.cloudfront: Distribution with OAC SigV4, Trusted Key Group RSA-2048, signed URL policy with IP restriction and 30s TTL
config.query_string_policy: Cache behavior allowlist: format, locale, version. Non-listed parameters stripped at edge.
config.origin_header_validation: Lambda@Edge origin-request adds X-Origin-Verify HMAC token; ALB rule validates presence
config.network: ALB SG inbound restricted to com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list only
config.waf: None attached — relies on CloudFront query string stripping and signed URL access control
